title: Couple view
subtitle: {me} and {partner} · You both agreed on {date} to check for shared results
subtitleNoDate: {me} and {partner} · You both agreed to check for shared results
sharedCount: {count, plural, one {# shared condition} other {# shared conditions}}
chancesTitle: {condition}: your shared chances, for each pregnancy
bothCarry: You both carry a change in the {gene} gene.
bothCarryNoGene: You both carry a change linked to this condition.
children: Four example children: {affected} with {condition}, {carrier} healthy carriers, {unaffected} with no changed copy
same: These chances are the same for every pregnancy. Having one affected child doesn't make the next one less or more likely.
counsellorOnly: For this condition, chances depend on more than two results. A genetic counsellor will go through them with you.
noneSharedBody: You don't carry a change in the same gene, so your children aren't expected to have these conditions from you both.
elseTitle: Everything else you were both screened for
elseBody: No other shared results were found. Your individual results for other conditions stay private, even from each other.
background: A small background chance of an inherited condition exists for every couple, because no screening covers every gene change.
partnerShared: {partner} also chose to share: carrier of {list}.

simulator.title: See how it works
simulator.body: Simulate pregnancies in the inheritance simulator.

counsellor.title: Talk it through together
counsellor.body: Book a couple session with a counsellor.

footer: This is information, not a recommendation. Every option is valid, and the decision is yours.

no_partner.title: Invite your partner
no_partner.body: The couple view checks for shared results only when you both agree. Invite your partner to start.

consent_missing.title: Nothing is shared until you both agree
consent_missing.body: Choose what you'd like to share. Your partner chooses separately.

result_missing.title: Waiting for both results
result_missing.body: The couple view needs both of your screening results. Once you've both added them, shared results appear here.

flagged.title: Talk it through with a counsellor together
flagged.body: One of your results needs a specialist to explain it, so the couple view doesn't show chances. A counsellor will go through everything with you both.

consent.title: Unlock your couple view
consent.subtitle: Nothing is shared until you both agree. You can change your mind at any time.
consent.whatSeeBody: Choose how much of your result to share. {partner} chooses separately.

shared_only.title: Shared results only
shared_only.body: {partner} sees only conditions you both carry. Your other results stay private, even from them.

summary.title: Summary
summary.body: Every condition you carry and your carrier status, for example “Carrier: beta-thalassemia, SMA”.

full.title: Full report
full.body: Everything in the summary, plus the details of your screening report.

consent.bothSee1: Any condition you both carry, and your chances for each pregnancy
consent.agree: I agree to unlock our couple view
consent.note: You can withdraw at any time in Privacy & consent. Withdrawing closes the couple view for both of you straight away.
consent.whyBody: Your result belongs to you. A couple view only makes sense when both of you choose it, so neither of you can see the other's information without permission.
consent.saved: Saved. Nothing is shared until you both agree.
consent.withdrawn: Withdrawn. The couple view is closed for both of you.
consent.error: That didn't work. Please try again.
consent.noPartner: Invite your partner first. Once you're linked, you can each choose what to share.
